reason: The plugin is primarily a UI navigation enhancement for a web chat session, adding a dedicated message rail to help users move through long conversation history. Evidence shows it renders a session-side panel with hover previews, tracks viewport position, and jumps to user-message anchors, so the best fit is navigation-panels with supporting UI/data handling rather than automation, integration, or code-generation functionality.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话界面中提供左侧消息轨道导航，可快速查看历史用户消息并支持悬停预览与点击跳转。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a left-side message rail in the DeepSeek Harness chat view to navigate long conversation history with hover previews and one-click jumps to past user messages.

capabilities: Injects a custom web UI rail component into the conversation page of DeepSeek Harness
Loads and indexes session messages (user messages) for in-plugin navigation
Provides hover previews and click-to-scroll navigation to message anchors
Uses virtualized rendering for rail markers to limit DOM pressure
Automatically loads older conversation pages to build a fuller index when needed

reasons.code: README describes a left-side Codex-style message rail for DeepSeek Harness Web with hover preview and click jump behavior.
Package manifest declares a DSH web client plugin with bundle patch injection and no server-side modules or external services.
README lists use of session.loadOlder/hasMore/loadingOlder to page through history and index past user messages for the rail.
